title: An unramified algebra over a field is a finite product of finite separable extensions
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $C$ a commutative $k$-algebra such that the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ induced by the structure map [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism]. Then there are an integer $n\ge0$, fields $L_1,\dots,L_n$, each a field extension of $k$ [def-pc-field-extension] which is finite ($\dim_kL_j<\infty$) and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and an isomorphism of $k$-algebras $C\cong L_1\times\cdots\times L_n$ (for $n=0$ the zero ring). (Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma [02G7] part (1), affine case; the same assertion appears in the proof of Algebra, Lemma [00UW] for the fibre ring $F=S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ of an unramified ring map.)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G7 (morphisms-lemma-unramified-over-field, line 7790), part (1), direction 'unramified implies disjoint union of spectra of finite separable extensions', applied to the affine scheme Spec C (quasi-compact, so finitely many points); also Algebra, Lemma 00UW (algebra-lemma-unramified-at-prime, algebra.tex line 41568), proof lines 41584-41591 ('F = S (x)_R kappa(p) is a finite product of finite separable field extensions of kappa(p)', via Algebra Lemmas 00UV (lemma-unramified), 00TT (lemma-characterize-smooth-over-field) and 00U3 (lemma-etale-over-field))

proof.text: Unramified ring map. Since $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is the morphism induced by the structure map $k\to C$ and is unramified, [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-ring-map-iff-unramified-affine] (direction 'only if') shows that $C$ is a finitely generated $k$-algebra and $\Omega_{C/k}=0$; that is, $k\to C$ is an unramified ring map in the sense of Algebra, Definition 00UT. (In Stacks, Morphisms, Lemma 02G7 this is the passage from the scheme to the ring map via Definition 02G4 and Lemma 02G6; in the proof of Lemma 00UW the fibre ring is unramified over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ by Lemma 00UV.)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G7 (lemma-unramified-over-field, line 7790), proof of part (1), and Lemmas 02GE, 02G6

proof.text: Étale. A finitely generated $k$-algebra with $\Omega_{C/k}=0$ over the field $k$ is étale over $k$ by [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-ring-map-over-field-etale]: $C$ is finitely presented over $k$, $H_1(L_{C/k})=0$ and $\Omega_{C/k}=0$. (Stacks: 'By Lemma 00TT it is smooth hence étale over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$'.)

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma 00UW (algebra-lemma-unramified-at-prime, line 41568), lines 41579-41591, sentence 'By Lemma 00TT (lemma-characterize-smooth-over-field) it is smooth hence etale over kappa(p)'

proof.text: Back to schemes. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine] (direction 'if'), applied to $\varphi:k\to C$, the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is étale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma 00UW (algebra-lemma-unramified-at-prime, line 41568), lines 41579-41591 (the étale ring map is then fed to Lemma 00U3)

proof.text: Product decomposition. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-over-field-product] applied to the étale morphism $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ there are $n\ge0$, field extensions $L_1,\dots,L_n$ of $k$, each finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and an isomorphism of $k$-algebras $C\cong L_1\times\cdots\times L_n$ (the zero ring for $n=0$). This is the assertion.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma 00UW (algebra-lemma-unramified-at-prime, line 41568), lines 41579-41591, sentence 'Hence F = S (x)_R kappa(p) is a finite product of finite separable field extensions of kappa(p), see Lemma 00U3 (lemma-etale-over-field)'

Proof written in four steps following the proof of Algebra 00UW: (1) Spec translation to an unramified ring map (finite type, Omega=0) by the new leaf lem-weil-pbc-unramified-ring-map-iff-unramified-affine (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff for LocallyOfFiniteType and FormallyUnramified plus the diagonal instances); (2) unramified over a field implies etale by the new leaf lem-weil-pbc-unramified-ring-map-over-field-etale (Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_formallyUnramified_of_field + Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType; Stacks 'by 00TT smooth hence etale'); (3) back to Spec C -> Spec k etale by the leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine; (4) the leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-over-field-product (Stacks 00U3, Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod, with finiteness of the factors). Not used: lem-weil-pbc-unramified-over-field-discrete (Stacks 02G7's topological route is not needed in the affine case). All cited nodes are in unit sk-thm-p1 or are definitions.
